import { CommonModule, DatePipe, NgFor, NgIf } from '@angular/common'; import { Component, OnInit, inject } from '@angular/core'; import { FormBuilder, ReactiveFormsModule, Validators } from '@angular/forms'; import { NotificationService } from '../../core/services/notification.service'; import { ResourceItem, ResourceService } from '../../core/services/resource.service'; import { MovementHistory, Tire, TireService } from '../../core/services/tire.service'; @Component({ selector: 'app-tires', standalone: true, imports: [CommonModule, ReactiveFormsModule, NgFor, NgIf, DatePipe], template: `
Inventario

Gestion de gomas y ubicaciones

Da de alta gomas, actualiza sus datos tecnicos y consulta su historial completo por unidad.

Filtros rapidos

{{ tires.length }} visibles

{{ editingId ? 'Editar goma' : 'Nueva goma' }}

{{ editingId ? 'Edicion' : 'Alta' }}

Stock actual

Codigo Marca Modelo Medida Estado Ubicacion Acciones
{{ tire.code }} {{ tire.brand }} {{ tire.model }} {{ tire.size }} {{ tire.state }} {{ tire.locationDetail.label }}
{{ getLocationCaption(tire) }}

{{ selectedTire?.code ? 'Historial de ' + selectedTire?.code : 'Historial' }}

{{ item.previousLocation }} -> {{ item.newLocation }}

{{ item.previousPlate || 'Sin patente' }} -> {{ item.newPlate || 'Sin patente' }}

{{ item.notes || 'Sin observaciones' }}

{{ item.user.name }} | {{ item.createdAt | date:'short' }}

Selecciona una goma para ver su historial de movimientos.
`, }) export class TiresComponent implements OnInit { private readonly fb = inject(FormBuilder); private readonly tireService = inject(TireService); private readonly resourceService = inject(ResourceService); private readonly notificationService = inject(NotificationService); tires: Tire[] = []; history: MovementHistory[] = []; selectedTire: Tire | null = null; editingId: string | null = null; deposits: ResourceItem[] = []; tractors: ResourceItem[] = []; semis: ResourceItem[] = []; readonly filtersForm = this.fb.nonNullable.group({ search: [''], state: [''], locationType: [''], }); readonly tireForm = this.fb.nonNullable.group({ code: ['', Validators.required], brand: ['', Validators.required], model: ['', Validators.required], size: ['', Validators.required], state: ['NUEVA', Validators.required], currentLocation: ['DEPOSIT', Validators.required], depositId: [''], semiId: [''], tractorId: [''], notes: [''], }); ngOnInit(): void { this.loadResources(); this.loadTires(); } loadResources(): void { this.resourceService.getDeposits().subscribe((items) => (this.deposits = items)); this.resourceService.getTractors().subscribe((items) => (this.tractors = items)); this.resourceService.getSemis().subscribe((items) => (this.semis = items)); } loadTires(): void { this.tireService.getAll(this.filtersForm.getRawValue()).subscribe((items) => (this.tires = items)); } getLocationCaption(tire: Tire): string { if (tire.locationDetail.type === 'DEPOSIT') { return 'Ubicada en deposito'; } return tire.locationDetail.plate ? `Patente ${tire.locationDetail.plate}` : 'Vehiculo asignado'; } saveTire(): void { if (this.tireForm.invalid) { this.tireForm.markAllAsTouched(); return; } const payload = this.tireForm.getRawValue(); const request = this.editingId ? this.tireService.update(this.editingId, payload) : this.tireService.create(payload); request.subscribe({ next: () => { this.notificationService.show('success', this.editingId ? 'Goma actualizada.' : 'Goma registrada.'); this.resetForm(); this.loadTires(); }, error: (error) => { this.notificationService.show('error', error.error?.message || 'No se pudo guardar la goma.'); }, }); } editTire(tire: Tire): void { this.editingId = tire.id; this.tireForm.patchValue({ code: tire.code, brand: tire.brand, model: tire.model, size: tire.size, state: tire.state, currentLocation: tire.currentLocation, notes: tire.notes || '', }); } showHistory(tire: Tire): void { this.selectedTire = tire; this.tireService.getHistory(tire.id).subscribe((history) => (this.history = history)); } resetForm(): void { this.editingId = null; this.tireForm.reset({ code: '', brand: '', model: '', size: '', state: 'NUEVA', currentLocation: 'DEPOSIT', depositId: '', semiId: '', tractorId: '', notes: '', }); } }
